title: 简单蒸馏与分馏
source_doc: course/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/15_Distillation I.md
author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/15_Distillation I/src.py

points.K7: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半
points.K12: 接上蒸馏头、冷凝管和接收瓶
points.K15: 磨口涂脂，热处不用塑料夹
points.S2: 加热套与调压器的用电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一套蒸馏装置旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a glass distillation setup with a round-bottom flask in a heating mantle, a condenser and a receiving flask, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课学简单蒸馏和分馏。

shots.scene: 简单蒸馏和分馏两套装置图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a simple distillation setup and one with a tall column between flask and head. No people.
shots.narration: 装置怎么搭、怎么控速、哪里最危险，都讲。

shots.scene: 阿杰把接收瓶接口用塞子堵严，准备开热
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a stopper into the side outlet of the adapter and reaches for the heater knob.
shots.narration: 阿杰想蒸一瓶溶剂，把出口堵得严严实实。

shots.scene: 小研急忙拦住，指着被堵的出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student quickly stops him and points at the blocked outlet.
shots.narration: 小研说：封闭加热会炸！

shots.scene: 欣欣在装置前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of the distillation setup.
shots.narration: 蒸馏规矩多，我们一条条来。

shots.scene: 两种液体混在一个烧瓶里，分成两个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: One flask of mixed liquid splits by arrows into two separate flasks. No people.
shots.narration: 分离液体混合物，或除去不挥发杂质。

shots.scene: 温度计图标和两个不同高度的沸点标记
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with two boiling marks at different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 靠的是它们的沸点不同。

shots.scene: 液滴变成蒸气向上
shots.prompt_en: A droplet turning into rising vapor lines with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 汽化：液体变成气体。

shots.scene: 蒸气遇冷变回液滴
shots.prompt_en: Vapor meeting a cold surface and turning back into droplets with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝：气体变回液体。

shots.scene: 烧瓶加热，混合液沸腾
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask heated in a mantle with the mixture gently boiling. No people.
shots.narration: 加热混合物，易挥发的先沸腾。

shots.scene: 蒸气经蒸馏头进冷凝管，冷水在夹套里流
shots.prompt_en: Vapor rises through the distilling head into a condenser with cold water flowing in its jacket. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气经蒸馏头，进入冷凝管。

shots.scene: 冷凝下来的液体流进接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Condensed liquid drips into a receiving flask sitting in an ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却成液体，流进接收瓶。

shots.scene: 三种蒸馏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a simple setup, a setup with a tall column, and a setup with a vacuum hose. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸馏有三种，按液体性质选。

shots.scene: 简单蒸馏卡片：低沸点、沸点差大
shots.prompt_en: A card with a simple setup icon, a low thermometer and a big gap between two marks. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点低于一百五十度，用简单蒸馏。

shots.scene: 一种液体和不挥发杂质，或沸点差大的两种液体
shots.prompt_en: Two examples: a liquid with solid specks left behind, and two liquids with widely separated boiling marks. No people.
shots.narration: 分开不挥发杂质，或沸点差二十五度以上。

shots.scene: 沸点很接近的两个标记，分馏柱图标
shots.prompt_en: Two boiling marks very close together beside a fractionating column icon. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点差小于二十五度，用分馏。

shots.scene: 高温计图标和真空管图标
shots.prompt_en: A high thermometer icon next to a vacuum hose icon with a next-lesson arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点高于一百五十度用减压，下节讲。

shots.scene: 台面上摆出烧瓶、蒸馏头、冷凝管、接引管、温度计
shots.prompt_en: On a black bench: a round-bottom flask on a cork ring, a distilling head, a condenser, a vacuum adapter and a thermometer with adapter. No people.
shots.narration: 备好烧瓶、蒸馏头、冷凝管、接引管。

shots.scene: 铁架台、烧瓶夹、铁圈、加热套、调压器
shots.prompt_en: Two ring stands, extension clamps, an iron ring, a heating mantle and a variable voltage controller with a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 铁架台、夹子、铁圈、加热套、调压器。

shots.scene: 塑料磨口夹、管箍、橡胶管、接收瓶、冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: Plastic joint clips, hose clamps, rubber tubing, three receiving flasks and an ice bath bowl. No people.
shots.narration: 还有磨口夹、管箍、水管和接收瓶。

shots.section_title: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半
shots.scene: 烧瓶液面在三分之一到一半之间，刻线标出
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask filled between one third and one half, with two marker lines. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半。
overlay: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半

shots.section_title: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半
shots.scene: 装太满的烧瓶暴沸冲进冷凝管的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overfilled flask bumping liquid up into the condenser, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太满会暴沸，杂质冲进接收瓶。

shots.section_title: 蒸馏瓶装三分之一到一半
shots.scene: 装太少的烧瓶，大部分空间被蒸气占据
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a nearly empty flask with vapor filling it and a small loss icon. No people.
shots.narration: 太少，光充满蒸气就要损失不少。

shots.scene: 小加热套套大烧瓶、接触不好的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small heating mantle under a big flask with gaps and a burn mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热套绝不能比烧瓶小，会烧坏。

shots.scene: 大加热套里放小烧瓶，往空隙里倒沙
shots.prompt_en: A small flask sits in a larger heating mantle and sand is poured into the gap.
shots.narration: 没有合适的就用大的，空隙填沙。

shots.scene: 镊子把搅拌子放进烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand drops a small stir bar into the flask on a cork ring.
shots.narration: 样品倒进烧瓶，放一根搅拌子。

shots.scene: 没有搅拌器时，刮勺加几粒沸石
shots.prompt_en: A spatula adds a few boiling stones to a cool flask. No people.
shots.narration: 没有磁力搅拌，就加几粒沸石。

shots.scene: 烧瓶颈用夹子固定在铁架台
shots.prompt_en: The flask neck is clamped to a ring stand with an extension clamp.
shots.narration: 烧瓶颈夹在铁架台上。

shots.scene: 加热套接调压器，放在铁圈上
shots.prompt_en: A heating mantle plugged into a voltage controller rests on an iron ring under the flask; a magnetic stirrer sits below it. No people.
shots.narration: 加热套接调压器，放在铁圈上。

shots.scene: 加热套下面是磁力搅拌器
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the magnetic stirrer under the heating mantle. No people.
shots.narration: 用搅拌子，下面再放磁力搅拌器。

shots.scene: 铁圈连同加热套向下移开
shots.prompt_en: The iron ring with the heating mantle slides down away from the flask, leaving space. No people.
shots.narration: 铁圈下留空间，随时能把加热套降下来。

shots.section_title: 接上蒸馏头、冷凝管和接收瓶
shots.scene: 蒸馏头装上烧瓶，冷凝管接侧臂
shots.prompt_en: A distilling head is fitted on the flask and a condenser is joined to its side arm.
shots.narration: 装上蒸馏头，冷凝管接侧臂。
overlay: 接上蒸馏头、冷凝管和接收瓶

shots.section_title: 接上蒸馏头、冷凝管和接收瓶
shots.scene: 接引管接冷凝管末端，夹在第二个铁架台
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum adapter is attached to the end of the condenser and clamped to a second ring stand. No people.
shots.narration: 接引管接冷凝管，夹在第二个铁架台。

shots.section_title: 接上蒸馏头、冷凝管和接收瓶
shots.scene: 小接收瓶用塑料夹接上，下面冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: A small receiving flask is secured to the adapter with a plastic joint clip and set into an ice bath. No people.
shots.narration: 小接收瓶用塑料夹夹好，放进冰水浴。

shots.scene: 温度计经套管插进蒸馏头顶部
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer is inserted through an adapter into the top of the distilling head and clipped. No people.
shots.narration: 温度计经套管装在蒸馏头顶上。

shots.scene: 水银球上沿与侧臂下沿平齐的放大图
shots.prompt_en: Magnified diagram: the top of the thermometer bulb level with the bottom of the side arm, marked by a dashed line. No people.
shots.narration: 球的上沿，和侧臂下沿平齐。

shots.scene: 冷凝管两端夹好，水管用管箍固定
shots.prompt_en: Both ends of the condenser are clipped; rubber hoses on its water ports are tightened with hose clamps. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管两头夹牢，水管用管箍箍紧。

shots.scene: 装置旁放着两个干净的接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two clean dry receiving flasks wait on cork rings next to the setup. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边再备两个干净干燥的接收瓶。

shots.section_title: 磨口涂脂，热处不用塑料夹
shots.scene: 手指在磨口上抹一薄层润滑脂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger spreads a thin film of grease on a ground glass joint.
shots.narration: 所有磨口，轻轻涂一层润滑脂。
overlay: 磨口涂脂，热处不用塑料夹

shots.section_title: 磨口涂脂，热处不用塑料夹
shots.scene: 塑料夹夹在烧瓶热接口上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plastic clip on the hot joint right above the heating mantle, melting, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 会变热的接口，不用塑料夹。

shots.scene: 冷凝管下口进水、上口出水的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show water entering the lower port of the condenser and leaving from the upper port to a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝水下口进，上口出到水槽。

shots.scene: 夹套里充满水，没有气泡
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the condenser jacket completely full of water with no air bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 下进上出，夹套里才不会存气泡。

shots.scene: 手指检查每个管箍
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand checks each hose clamp on the condenser tubing.
shots.narration: 开水前，再查一遍管箍。

shots.scene: 水龙头只开一点，细细水流
shots.prompt_en: A tap opened only a little, sending a gentle steady flow. No people.
shots.narration: 水流开到能冷却就够了。

shots.scene: 水开太大、水管冲脱喷水的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hose popping off the condenser and spraying water everywhere, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开太大，水管会冲脱，喷一桌子。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮慢慢调高
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slowly turns up the knob of the voltage controller. No people.
shots.narration: 打开调压器，加热到平稳沸腾。

shots.scene: 接引管侧口敞开，箭头通向空气
shots.prompt_en: The side outlet of the vacuum adapter is open with an arrow pointing out to the air. No people.
shots.narration: 接引管侧口必须通大气。

shots.scene: 密闭装置加热鼓胀炸裂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed glass setup swelling and cracking under heat, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能加热密闭体系，会爆炸！

shots.scene: 冷凝环沿瓶壁上升到蒸馏头
shots.prompt_en: A ring of condensing vapor climbs up the flask wall into the distilling head. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝环慢慢升到蒸馏头。

shots.scene: 温度计读数骤然上升，球上挂着液滴
shots.prompt_en: The thermometer reading jumps up as a droplet forms on the bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气到达水银球，温度一下跳上来。

shots.scene: 冷凝环停住，调压器稍调高
shots.prompt_en: The condensate ring stops partway; the controller knob turns up slightly. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝环停住不动，稍微调高电压。

shots.scene: 小接收瓶里滴入约十滴
shots.prompt_en: Drops fall into the small receiving flask, a counter icon reaching ten. No people.
shots.narration: 先接十滴左右前馏分。

shots.scene: 迅速换上大接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands quickly swap the small flask for a larger receiving flask and clip it on.
shots.narration: 迅速换上大接收瓶。

shots.scene: 小瓶里的前馏分倒向废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The first drops from the small flask are poured into a waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 最初几滴可能有低沸点杂质，不要。

shots.scene: 液滴稳定滴下，钟表图标
shots.prompt_en: Distillate drips steadily into the flask beside a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 主馏分大约每分钟十滴。

shots.scene: 滴得太快带出杂质、太慢钟表转圈的对比
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a fast stream with impurity dots, and a slow drip with a spinning clock. No people.
shots.narration: 太快混进杂质，太慢太费时间。

shots.scene: 温度计球上没有液滴，读数骤降
shots.prompt_en: The thermometer bulb is dry and the reading drops sharply. No people.
shots.narration: 低沸点的蒸完了，温度突然下降。

shots.scene: 立刻换上新的小接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands swap in a new small receiving flask. No people.
shots.narration: 马上换新的小瓶，接最后几滴。

shots.scene: 最后几滴里带着高沸点杂质的示意
shots.prompt_en: The last few drops shown with small impurity dots, kept apart from the main flask. No people.
shots.narration: 这几滴可能有高沸点杂质，别混进主瓶。

shots.scene: 记录本上一段温度范围
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook with a temperature band sketched on it. No people.
shots.narration: 记下从沸腾到骤降前的温度范围。

shots.scene: 范围很窄，勾号
shots.prompt_en: A narrow temperature band with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 范围在两度以内，就比较纯。

shots.scene: 接完最后几滴，关掉调压器
shots.prompt_en: After the last drops, the voltage controller is turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 收完最后几滴，关闭热源。

shots.scene: 五要点清单前两条：接口紧、装量
shots.prompt_en: A checklist board with two icons: a tight joint with a hose clamp, and a flask filled one third to half. No people.
shots.narration: 要点：接口紧、水管牢、装量合适。

shots.scene: 清单继续：滴速、三个接收瓶
shots.prompt_en: The checklist continues with a ten drops per minute clock and three receiving flasks for start, middle and end. No people.
shots.narration: 每分钟十滴，前中后分瓶接。

shots.scene: 蒸干的烧瓶过热开裂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry flask overheating and cracking in the mantle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能蒸干，会过热破裂！

shots.scene: 两个沸点很近的标记，问号
shots.prompt_en: Two boiling marks almost touching with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 沸点很近的两种液体，用分馏。

shots.scene: 分馏柱内部有很多突刺，表面积大
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a fractionating column with many glass spikes inside, large surface area highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 分馏柱里表面积大，像做了很多次小蒸馏。

shots.scene: 蒸气在柱底冷凝成液滴，颜色偏向低沸点
shots.prompt_en: Animated diagram: vapor condenses into droplets at the bottom of the column, droplets tinted toward the low boiling color. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气在柱底冷凝，低沸点的多一些。

shots.scene: 液滴再汽化，在更高处冷凝
shots.prompt_en: The droplets re-vaporize and condense higher up, each step more strongly tinted. No people.
shots.narration: 再汽化、再冷凝，一级级往上。

shots.scene: 柱顶只剩一种颜色的蒸气
shots.prompt_en: At the top of the column only one color of vapor remains. No people.
shots.narration: 到柱顶，理论上就是纯的低沸点组分。

shots.scene: 在烧瓶和蒸馏头之间插入分馏柱
shots.prompt_en: A fractionating column is fitted between the flask and the distilling head.
shots.narration: 烧瓶和蒸馏头之间加一根分馏柱。

shots.scene: 一体式分馏装置
shots.prompt_en: An all-in-one distillation apparatus with a built-in column and several receiving flasks. No people.
shots.narration: 也可用一体式仪器，操作和简单蒸馏一样。

shots.scene: 调压器只调高一点点，升温箭头平缓
shots.prompt_en: The controller knob nudged up only slightly; a gentle rising arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 分馏要非常慢地加热。

shots.scene: 加热太猛，柱内液体冲成一片的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a column flooded with rushing vapor and liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太猛，柱里来不及达到平衡。

shots.scene: 加热太弱，蒸气走到一半就冷了
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of vapor stalling halfway up a cold column with blue cold marks. No people.
shots.narration: 太弱，蒸气爬不到柱顶。

shots.scene: 分馏柱外包一层保温材料再裹铝箔
shots.prompt_en: A fractionating column wrapped in an insulating layer and then aluminum foil. No people.
shots.narration: 柱子散热太快，就包上保温层和铝箔。

shots.scene: 液滴稳定滴下，钟表每两三秒一跳
shots.prompt_en: A drop falls steadily into the receiver as a clock icon ticks every few seconds. No people.
shots.narration: 慢而稳，两三秒一滴最合适。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一瓶清澈的馏出液
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flask of clear distillate and smiles.
shots.narration: 方法对了，纯度和收率都好。

shots.scene: 调压器归零，加热套降下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the voltage controller to zero and lowers the heating mantle away from the flask.
shots.narration: 停蒸馏：先关热源，降下加热套。

shots.scene: 烧瓶冷却，冷凝水还开着
shots.prompt_en: The flask cools while water still flows through the condenser, a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝水继续开着，等烧瓶凉下来。

shots.scene: 关水，再从上往下拆装置
shots.prompt_en: The tap is closed, then the female graduate student takes the glassware apart from the receiver end.
shots.narration: 凉了再关水，然后拆装置。

shots.scene: 先关水后停热的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of closing the water tap while the mantle is still glowing hot, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 先关水，蒸气会从接口冲出来。

shots.section_title: 加热套与调压器的用电
shots.scene: 调压器旋钮在零位，再插电
shots.prompt_en: The voltage controller knob set at zero before the plug goes into the socket. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器先归零，再插电开机。
overlay: 加热套与调压器的用电

shots.section_title: 加热套与调压器的用电
shots.scene: 电线搭在热的加热套上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power cord lying across a hot heating mantle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线别搭在热面上，远离冷凝水管。

shots.section_title: 加热套与调压器的用电
shots.scene: 加热套里洒进液体的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid spilling into a heating mantle with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热套里洒了液体，立即断电处理。

shots.scene: 整套蒸馏装置搭在通风柜里，柜门拉低
shots.prompt_en: A complete distillation setup assembled inside a fume hood with the sash lowered.
shots.narration: 蒸易燃、有毒溶剂，装置搭在通风柜里。

shots.scene: 接引管侧口接一根管子引向柜内后方
shots.prompt_en: A tube from the adapter side outlet leads toward the back of the fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 通大气的出口，蒸气引向通风处。

shots.scene: 王老师看着柜门高度点头
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the sash height and nods.
shots.narration: 柜门高度按本校规定。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套和护目镜，用玻璃棉缠柱子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in gloves and goggles, wraps insulating glass wool around the column.
shots.narration: 玻璃棉纤维扎手，戴手套护目镜。

shots.scene: 抖动玻璃棉、纤维飘散的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of shaking glass wool with fibers floating in the air, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别抖动扬起，碎屑装袋丢弃。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现装量线和加热套图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a half-filled flask and a heating mantle.
shots.narration: 装三分之一到一半，加热套宁大勿小。

shots.scene: 冷凝管下进上出与管箍图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a condenser with bottom-in top-out arrows and hose clamps. No people.
shots.narration: 下进上出，管箍箍紧，水流适中。

shots.scene: 通大气出口与禁止密闭图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an open outlet and a crossed-out sealed setup. No people.
shots.narration: 通大气，不密闭，不蒸干。

shots.scene: 三个接收瓶和分馏柱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of three receiving flasks and a fractionating column. No people.
shots.narration: 前中后分瓶，分馏慢热保温。

shots.scene: 停热、冷却、关水、拆卸四步图标
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in order: heat off, cooling, water off, take apart. No people.
shots.narration: 停热、冷却、关水、拆卸，按顺序来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着馏出液挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a flask of clear distillate and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 蒸得纯，做得稳，下次见！
